Platform-specific async timing exposes an error or empty state before the profile becomes available.
iOS and Android use different screen or header components rather than a shared responsive implementation.

Normalize both screenshots to the same effective viewport and crop bounds before pixel comparison, and wait for the same deterministic screen state.
